signatureEncoding: v3: followed by canonical Base64 of 64 signature bytes
messageEncoding: UTF-8 fields joined by |, no trailing separator

constraints.provider: 1..31 ASCII letters, digits, underscore or hyphen
constraints.request_id: 16 lowercase hex digits derived by the coordinator
constraints.bits: 8 lowercase hex digits, most-significant bit first
constraints.timestamps: positive Unix seconds bounded by the original 45-second request

trust: A signature binds execution claims to the enrolled key. Camera observations and installed-firmware provenance remain separate checks.
safety: Physical emission requires an explicitly selected board driver and separate actuation authorization. No default GPIO is safe to infer.
